title: Mumbai Street Style Masala Pav Recipe | Masala Pattice | पाव Street Food of India | Chef Kunal Kapur
description: Masala Pav is one of the most popular Mumbai street food after Pav Bhaji. Soft melt in mouth Pav slathered in spicy tomato-onion masala, Masala means spicy mixture and pav is an eggless dinner roll. Quick and easy masala pav, is made by stuffing spicy tomato-onion gravy inside butter-laden Ladi pav. Enjoy this easy to make snacks recipe!   #पाव #masalapav #streetfood #PavRecipe #KunalKapurRecipes  Hi, I am Chef Kunal Kapur and this is my space, my channel. asr.full_text: Music Today we are going to make Masala Pav And the main know-how of Masala Pav is not a spice It is Pav, which means Pav bread Pav is what we call as Pao bread. This Pao specially when you go to Maharashtra, go to Gujrat, will definitely be liked as a part of street food. So it is quick snack and extremely tasty so lets make Masala Pav. Now for Masala Pav firstly I'll use a red chilli paste. And this red chilli paste will get made by this red chilli, which I had soaked for another hour in water, I'll add 4-5 shallots, more or less, a little garlic, little ginger, and little garam masala, a little water will go in it, & grind it. Add all the spices and grind them in little water. Our Pabu is ready. Mmmm, amazing. Don't do that at home. I feel like having all this. We also have the Pabav and we need to make the masala For that we need butter So the awesome thing is that the masala will be made with the same use only of the onion, tomato and black pepper Nobody else use vegetables To roast the onions until the color changes To remove some raw taste Now we will add some green chilies as per the taste See when we made the chilli paste in to is made and we added ginger and ginger so we are not adding individually, but if you do not have whole mix and you can use Kashmiri chilli powder, you can add Kashmiri chilli powder and you can add chopped ginger garlic and you can also fry with onion the most important herb masala would go in this is cumin powder and coriander powder along with it a little salt and we will roast the spices a little now, now you will have made the paste that you have given in, now it is ready to be cooked The Babaji Masala has got a little heat it's fragrance is coming out now Wow! put all the ingredients in the onion Now add 2 table spoon of the paste that we made now Chilli Peppers are cooking on open flame Its very important to avoid cough so keep the exhaust fan on Else everyone will suffer Nobody will show you this, because it is not the ideal place to heat the hot pan. Now I'll show you how much we can cook it and how much we can use it. This is only for the video's purpose. The reason is, I feel that only we are going to cook this on an electric stove, so this will cook quickly and nicely over low heat. I'll cook it for about 4-5 minutes, while cooking it, we will add some other ingredients to this. We will use this to help serve it to the guests. And you will we have to mash it with our hands. And in today's extra shots I will be telling you about the history of pav. Is pav Indian or the ones out of India? if you wish you can use a potato masher, that will also perfectly work. By doing this the tomato and the masala will & will add more thickness to the masala you can see now it has become mushy Now we will add capsicum Capsicum can have the best flavor add a pinch of salt Add a pinch of Lemon juice This is optional, but usually we add lemon juice in there it is optional but is has a bright red colour if tomatoes are very sour, you don't need it switch on the stove put the spice mixture on one side put this in a mixing bowl Now we will cut this pav into small pieces and a little butter will to this pav for it to heat well. And yes, we don't need to wipe the pan . This pav , just like this. Will continue to cook in side like this. Likewise, it will keep on cooking on the sides We have to cook it well And you see the actual taste of this pickle, this pav will bring its flavor Now, we'll take some coriander seeds We'll put coriander on it We'll make the Pav, and the masala will go over it We'll add it on top ofav. and again we will coat it well, If you want you can also add more masala on top of it, like this, And we will give it little time to fry. Ha! Look at that, that nice little bright thing. For making Masala Pav, there's a few tips and tricks with which you can make it tasty every time. Whenever you make a Masala Pav, keep in mind that you can add some extra vegetables in it. At the same time if you like cheese, then you can add cheese in that masala and if you bake pav at home, then you can add different flavors in it. Pav bhaji masala is the key to this masala, that is, you can make Pav bhaji masala at home or buy it from the store. But these are very important. While cooking the vegetables remember not to overcook the vegetables or brown them. You have to keep the onion, tomato and Capsicum raw. Also use the Potato Mash If you have the right amount of equipment. So the vegetables will be mashed a little. And if and little bit you can even add boiled potatoes I can guarantee that you will get a nice taste After 5-6 hours, the masala will have started to turn golden brown! Our Masala Pav is now ready to serve! And our poha is ready. Now lets know about the History of Pav. The history of pav means the quantity of masalas as such as Masala Pav. Pak or Pav is a simple kind of bread which is called the Laddi Pav or Ladde Pav. In India, we used to eat flat bread for a long time like chapati, paranja, roti etc. We did not have fermented bread where fermentation was done to double and triple the rise. What happened that when Portuguese took over, they started living here in Goa, down south. then it came to the point where Pav was invented or made. at that time yeast was used or yeast paste was used If they would have lost that time, then it was to be used so indian locals used to get scared and wondered what kind of bread they would get locals, and especially local Goans, got used to the art of those who went there to Bombay or Maharashtra, they started selling Pav. You will also remember in Hindi that these Portuguese took away their bread. so we will also make our bread from it. Then they started making bread loaf. If you can understand, in hindi we call it double roti. Have you ever thought Why Double Roti? When bread was made in English style, And once it cooked, the flour doubled in size. So the locals here used to say that it doubled in size. Thus the double roti. So this was our humble pav. And there are many versions of this pav. Hope you enjoyed watching this. If you have comments, do mention in the comments below. And of course Subscribe Like And Show Me Some Love.
